1.web: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
1.asv: Hear, mysons, the instruction of a father, And attend to know understanding:

2.web: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
2.asv: For I give you good doctrine; Forsake ye not my law.

3.web: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
3.asv: For I was a son unto my father, Tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.

4.web: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
4.asv: And he taught me, and said unto me: Let thy heart retain my words; Keep my commandments, and live;

5.web: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, neither swerve from the words of my mouth.
5.asv: Get wisdom, get understanding; Forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth;

6.web: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
6.asv: Forsake her not, and she will preserve thee; Love her, and she will keep thee.

7.web: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
7.asv: Wisdomisthe principal thing; therefore get wisdom; Yea, with all thy getting get understanding.

8.web: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor, when you embrace her.
8.asv: Exalt her, and she will promote thee; She will bring thee to honor, when thou dost embrace her.

9.web: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
9.asv: She will give to thy head a chaplet of grace; A crown of beauty will she deliver to thee.

10.web: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
10.asv: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; And the years of thy life shall be many.

11.web: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
11.asv: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in paths of uprightness.

12.web: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
12.asv: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; And if thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

13.web: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
13.asv: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: Keep her; for she is thy life.

14.web: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
14.asv: Enter not into the path of the wicked, And walk not in the way of evil men.

15.web: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
15.asv: Avoid it, pass not by it; Turn from it, and pass on.

16.web: For they don’t sleep, unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
16.asv: For they sleep not, except they do evil; And their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

17.web: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
17.asv: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.

18.web: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light, that shines more and more until the perfect day.
18.asv: But the path of the righteous is as the dawning light, That shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

19.web: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
19.asv: The way of the wicked is as darkness: They know not at what they stumble.

20.web: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
20.asv: My son, attend to my words; Incline thine ear unto my sayings.

21.web: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the midst of your heart.
21.asv: Let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep them in the midst of thy heart.

22.web: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
22.asv: For they are life unto those that find them, And health to all their flesh.

23.web: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
23.asv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; For out of it are the issues of life.

24.web: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
24.asv: Put away from thee a wayward mouth, And perverse lips put far from thee.

25.web: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
25.asv: Let thine eyes look right on, And let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

26.web: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
26.asv: Make level the path of thy feet, And let all thy ways be established.

27.web: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
27.asv: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: Remove thy foot from evil.
